name: Vaporwave
description: Wide full-width letters with airy spacing.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text,o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charCodeAt(i); if(c>=33&&c<=126)o+=String.fromCharCode(c+65248); else if(c===32)o+="　"; else o+=t.charAt(i); } el.text=o.split("").join(" "); return el; }
